notes.title: Big Changes
notes.notes:
Game Description: "Worker Simulator: Cleaning the Abandoned Village"

Embark on a unique adventure as a brave cleaner striving to save an abandoned village from waste in rainy weather. Explore an open world filled with details, and tackle various challenges like collecting trash and repairing power stations. Use different tools, such as vacuum cleaners and cranes, to bring life back to the village. With each cleaning operation, watch the village transform and regain its beauty. Are you ready to be the hero of cleanliness? Start your adventure now and show the world that hard work can achieve the impossible!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.notes:
The following has been added
1- New cars with and without a trailer
2- Modifying and improving the map
3- Adding new area
4- Improving the transportation system and collecting resources
5- Improve frame rate

notes.title: Yes it's release time
notes.notes:
You can start your journey in Land 06. Keep going and don't stop, the fun is waiting for you.
Start creating your bank account within the game and start cleaning the city from garbage, collecting resources and selling them, and also buying cars and seeds, starting farming, harvesting fruits and selling them, and do not forget buying and raising animals and selling their meat.

notes.title: Big Update
notes.notes:
An update fixes technical problems and also adds and improves systems and gameplay. 
1- Adding more building elements, for example, new houses and an animal farm
2- Adding a system for carrying the item by hand
3- Improving the animal system, where you can now raise and care for animals
4- Improving the game world in general
5- Improving the user experience. Now you can play the game with high quality and higher frame rates
